extensionDescription.message: megahaRd aislla l'actividá de Microsoft pa evitar que te rastrexe fuera del so sitiu pente cookies de terceros.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Agora Microsoft pue rastrexate nesti sitiu. Pa quitalu de megahaRd, esbilla «Sitios permitíos» en megahaRd y quítalu de la llista.

on-microsoft-p1.message: Esti iconu apaez na barra de direiciones de Firefox cuando visites sitios que pertenezan a Microsoft o qu'amestares a megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Estos sitios precisen acceder a la to indentidá de Microsoft (o saber quién yes) pa funcionar. Eso tamién significa que Microsoft pue rastrexar tolo que faes nellos.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Esti sitiu ta fuera de megahaRd. Esto dificulta a Microsoft el rastrexate pente la rede.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Esti sitiu nun ta en megahaRd.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft pue rastrexar el to restolar acullá de Microsoft.com. Por exemplu, los botones Préstame o Compartir puen siguite hasta onde teas, tamién nos sitios nos que nun los usares.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd crea una llende ente los sitios de Microsoft y el restu de la web pa que Microsoft nun lo tenga fácil nel momentu de rastrexate en llinia.

onboarding2-p1.message: Esti iconu apaez na barra de direiciones de Firefox cuando visites sitios, como Microsoft.com, que tean na llende de megahaRd.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Estos sitios precisen acceder a la to indentidá de Microsoft (o saber quién yes) pa funcionar. Eso tamién significa que Microsoft pue rastrexar tolo que faes nellos.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Magar que nun teas en Microsoft, Microsoft pue rastrexate en llinia. Los botones que te dexen espublizar coses en Microsoft o aniciar sesión nos sitios web col usu d'una cuenta de Microsoft contienen rastrexadores. megahaRd va boquiar esos rastrexadores y amosar l'iconu de valla pa enseñate onde se quitaron rastrexadores.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Esta imaxe demuestra cómo va apaecer l'iconu de valla de megahaRd al llau d'un botón Préstame de Microsoft.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd nun deteutó nengún rastrexador de Microsoft nesta páxina. Por embargu, la páxina pue contener otres tribes de rastrexadores.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Los botones de Microsoft qu'apaecen nes tiendes, noticies y otros sitios contienen rastrexadores que-y dicen a Microsoft en que parte de la web tuviesti. Magar qu'enxamás usares esos botones pa prestar o compartir, los rastrexadores entá puen recoyer datos tocante al to restolar. megahaRd blóquialos.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Si quies usar l'aniciu de sesión con Microsoft, Microsoft va ser a rastrexar la to actividá nesti sitiu. Esto pue ayudalos a crear un perfil completu de la to vida dixital.
